connector.name: Openeye
connector.registryDescription: Procedure verification for AR/XR with memory, visual sessions, and DPO trajectory export.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package openeye. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the dumbspacecookie account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
env.description: Anthropic API key for the agent. Required because the default OpenEye agent uses Claude. Swap providers via src/models.ts if you want OPENAI/GROQ/GEMINI/etc.

env.name: OPENEYE_CONTEXT_OPTIN
env.description: Set true to opt in to sharing trajectory data with Context's training pipeline. Default off. Loud opt-in by design — read docs/context-data.md before flipping.

env.name: OPENEYE_CONTEXT_API_KEY
env.description: Context API key. Only needed if OPENEYE_CONTEXT_OPTIN is true.
